exception.reason: Existing automation retry synchronously clears its failure. Its unchanged100ms tick owns checking/deduplication; it is not an awaitable query refetch.

scope: 1280x720/100%, actual renderer/preload/main/service/storage with disposable data and local silent catalog. No live provider, audible quality, VoiceOver or uncoached listener proof.

decision.pair: Steve/Elena independently proposed shared busy affordance/ref lock and returned promises. After one challenge both support authoritative owner fetching state without a duplicate local pending state.
decision.root: Use per-query isFetching plus a synchronous promise-held lock. Preserve page-specific focus hook and existing read/write/paid-work boundaries.
decision.review: Steve found the compound playlist refresh needed the list query too; useIsFetching for that owned list was added without changing refresh ordering, then both/detail/list-only/ready/success boundaries were observed. A subsequent native search-switch reproduction exposed a stale lock. Parameterized notice/component identity keys now reset it with its query owner. Steve reviewed all remaining retry owners and found no missing identity boundary; his second review confirmed the corrected sibling keys are distinct.

freshness: The first14 core snapshots predate only the PlaylistDetail compound fetching correction; final4 core playlist snapshots include it. Four ownership snapshots use the final build including the identity keys. Prior core owner behavior is unchanged except that changing a query owner now remounts its notice.
limitations: Cold queries without prior data can replace the error with their existing loading presentation. The provider status case verifies that path and preservation of later field focus; it does not claim the notice remains mounted.
One early catalog probe had no cached filter data. The cached sibling case was staged only after a successful filter read; no app fix was inferred from that fixture state.

The catalog fixture initially consumed an older quit command and exited0. That terminal run is excluded; the command was cleared before the new run. The paging controller was also terminal before adding selective rule release.

An offscreen native Load more click returned elementHasNoFrame and a later stale target required refreshing the AX state. Subsequent visible paging recovery completed; these are tool-routing observations, not app failures.

During the compound list-only wait, CUA AX snapshots reported HTML-content focus while renderer telemetry still reported the Retrying button. The native tree exposed the busy button, but this does not prove OS/VoiceOver focus behavior. Q06/Q08/Q09 remain open.

A first compound assertion compared all IPC calls and caught normal news-status polling/local playback saves. The corrected assertion compares only the two owned playlist reads; local state persistence is not a server write.
The initial refs lint finding was fixed by destructuring the existing LibraryChooser hook result. No rule was suppressed or shared focus logic changed.
Anton chose to continue engineering checks first. Listener sessions remain pending; no usability score or inventory promotion follows from these states.

The ownership case uses a cold new search, so its retry replaces the error with the existing loading screen. An intermediate identity-key fix reused the virtual-list sibling key and left stale error markup, caught by the recovery assertion. Error keys now use an error prefix. The final run verifies no stale notice during current loading or after recovery, and playback stays paused. An intermediate batched Space after control unmount activated the existing page shortcut and was restored; that intermediate run is not counted as a final snapshot.
disposition: Partial Q06/Q08 evidence. All187 row dispositions unchanged;28 active checks remain.

ownershipReproduction.result: Confirmed before identity keys: new search Try again dispatched no new read while original request remained held.
